name: @gameshelf/contracts
description: Shared API contracts (Zod schemas + derived TypeScript types) for both the backend and the frontend

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:types && npm run build:cjs && npm run build:esm && npm run build:pkgjson
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n types,cjs,esm -c gray,gray,gray "tsc -p tsconfig.types.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput"
